[package]
name = "librespot-audio"
version = "0.8.0"
rust-version = "1.85"
authors = ["Paul Lietar <paul@lietar.net>"]
license = "MIT"
description = "The audio fetching logic for librespot"
repository = "https://github.com/librespot-org/librespot"
edition = "2024"

[features]
default = ["native-tls"]
native-tls = ["librespot-core/native-tls"]
rustls-tls-native-roots = ["librespot-core/rustls-tls-native-roots"]
rustls-tls-webpki-roots = ["librespot-core/rustls-tls-webpki-roots"]

[dependencies]
aes = "0.8"
bytes = "1"
ctr = "0.9"
http-body-util = "0.1"
log = "0.4"
tempfile = "3"
thiserror = "2"

[dependencies.librespot-core]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "../core"
default-features = false

[dependencies.futures-util]
version = "0.3"
default-features = false
features = ["std"]

[dependencies.hyper]
version = "1.6"
features = ["http1", "http2"]

[dependencies.hyper-util]
version = "0.1"
features = ["client", "http2"]

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["macros", "sync"]

[package]
name = "librespot-core"
version = "0.8.0"
rust-version = "1.85"
authors = ["Paul Lietar <paul@lietar.net>"]
license = "MIT"
description = "The core functionality provided by librespot"
repository = "https://github.com/librespot-org/librespot"
edition = "2024"
build = "build.rs"

[features]
default = ["native-tls"]
native-tls = ["dep:hyper-tls", "hyper-proxy2/tls", "librespot-oauth/native-tls", "tokio-tungstenite/native-tls"]
rustls-tls-native-roots = ["__rustls", "hyper-proxy2/rustls", "hyper-rustls/native-tokio", "librespot-oauth/rustls-tls-native-roots", "tokio-tungstenite/rustls-tls-native-roots"]
rustls-tls-webpki-roots = ["__rustls", "hyper-proxy2/rustls-webpki", "hyper-rustls/webpki-tokio", "librespot-oauth/rustls-tls-webpki-roots", "tokio-tungstenite/rustls-tls-webpki-roots"]
__rustls = []

[dependencies]
aes = "0.8"
base64 = "0.22"
byteorder = "1.5"
bytes = "1"
data-encoding = "2.9"
flate2 = "1.1"
form_urlencoded = "1.2"
futures-core = "0.3"
hmac = "0.12"
httparse = "1.10"
http = "1.3"
http-body-util = "0.1"
log = "0.4"
nonzero_ext = "0.3"
num-bigint = "0.4"
num-derive = "0.4"
num-integer = "0.1"
num-traits = "0.2"
pin-project-lite = "0.2"
priority-queue = "2.5"
protobuf = "3.7"
protobuf-json-mapping = "3.7"
rsa = "0.9"
serde_json = "1.0"
shannon = "0.2"
thiserror = "2"
url = "2"

[dependencies.librespot-oauth]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "../oauth"
default-features = false

[dependencies.librespot-protocol]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "../protocol"
default-features = false

[dependencies.futures-util]
version = "0.3"
default-features = false
features = ["alloc", "bilock", "unstable"]

[dependencies.governor]
version = "0.10"
default-features = false
features = ["std"]

[dependencies.hyper]
version = "1.6"
features = ["http1", "http2"]

[dependencies.hyper-proxy2]
version = "0.1"
default-features = false

[dependencies.hyper-rustls]
version = "0.27"
default-features = false
features = ["http1", "http2", "ring"]
optional = true

[dependencies.hyper-tls]
version = "0.6"
optional = true

[dependencies.hyper-util]
version = "0.1"
default-features = false
features = ["client", "http1", "http2"]

[dependencies.pbkdf2]
version = "0.12"
default-features = false
features = ["hmac"]

[dependencies.quick-xml]
version = "0.41"
features = ["serialize"]

[dependencies.rand]
version = "0.9"
default-features = false
features = ["thread_rng"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.sha1]
version = "0.10"
features = ["oid"]

[dependencies.sysinfo]
version = "0.36"
default-features = false
features = ["system"]

[dependencies.time]
version = "0.3"
features = ["formatting", "parsing"]

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["io-util", "macros", "net", "rt", "sync", "time"]

[dependencies.tokio-stream]
version = "0.1"
default-features = false

[dependencies.tokio-tungstenite]
version = "0.28"
default-features = false

[dependencies.tokio-util]
version = "0.7"
default-features = false

[dependencies.uuid]
version = "1"
default-features = false
features = ["v4"]

[build-dependencies]
rand_distr = "0.5"

[build-dependencies.rand]
version = "0.9"
default-features = false
features = ["thread_rng"]

[build-dependencies.vergen-gitcl]
version = "1.0"
default-features = false
features = ["build"]

[dev-dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["macros"]

[package]
name = "librespot-metadata"
version = "0.8.0"
rust-version = "1.85"
authors = ["Paul Lietar <paul@lietar.net>"]
license = "MIT"
description = "The metadata logic for librespot"
repository = "https://github.com/librespot-org/librespot"
edition = "2024"

[features]
default = ["native-tls"]
native-tls = ["librespot-core/native-tls"]
rustls-tls-native-roots = ["librespot-core/rustls-tls-native-roots"]
rustls-tls-webpki-roots = ["librespot-core/rustls-tls-webpki-roots"]

[dependencies]
async-trait = "0.1"
bytes = "1"
log = "0.4"
protobuf = "3.7"
serde_json = "1.0"
thiserror = "2"

[dependencies.librespot-core]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "../core"
default-features = false

[dependencies.librespot-protocol]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "../protocol"
default-features = false

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.uuid]
version = "1"
default-features = false

[package]
name = "librespot-oauth"
version = "0.8.0"
rust-version = "1.85"
authors = ["Nick Steel <nick@nsteel.co.uk>"]
license = "MIT"
description = "OAuth authorization code flow with PKCE for obtaining a Spotify access token"
repository = "https://github.com/librespot-org/librespot"
edition = "2024"

[features]
default = ["native-tls"]
native-tls = ["oauth2/native-tls", "reqwest/native-tls"]
rustls-tls-native-roots = ["__rustls", "oauth2/rustls-tls", "reqwest/rustls-tls-native-roots"]
rustls-tls-webpki-roots = ["__rustls", "oauth2/rustls-tls", "reqwest/rustls-tls-webpki-roots"]
__rustls = []

[dependencies]
log = "0.4"
open = "5.3"
thiserror = "2"
url = "2.5"

[dependencies.oauth2]
version = "5.0"
default-features = false
features = ["reqwest", "reqwest-blocking"]

[dependencies.reqwest]
version = "0.12"
default-features = false
features = ["system-proxy"]

[dev-dependencies.env_logger]
version = "0.11"
default-features = false
features = ["color", "humantime", "auto-color"]

[dev-dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["rt-multi-thread", "macros"]

[package]
name = "librespot-playback"
version = "0.8.0"
rust-version = "1.85"
authors = ["Sasha Hilton <sashahilton00@gmail.com>"]
license = "MIT"
description = "The audio playback logic for librespot"
repository = "https://github.com/librespot-org/librespot"
edition = "2024"

[features]
default = ["rodio-backend", "native-tls"]
alsa-backend = ["dep:alsa"]
gstreamer-backend = ["dep:gstreamer", "dep:gstreamer-app", "dep:gstreamer-audio"]
jackaudio-backend = ["dep:jack"]
portaudio-backend = ["dep:portaudio-rs"]
pulseaudio-backend = ["dep:libpulse-binding", "dep:libpulse-simple-binding"]
rodio-backend = ["dep:cpal", "dep:rodio"]
rodiojack-backend = ["dep:rodio", "cpal/jack"]
sdl-backend = ["dep:sdl2"]
passthrough-decoder = ["dep:ogg"]
native-tls = ["librespot-core/native-tls", "librespot-audio/native-tls", "librespot-metadata/native-tls"]
rustls-tls-native-roots = ["librespot-core/rustls-tls-native-roots", "librespot-audio/rustls-tls-native-roots", "librespot-metadata/rustls-tls-native-roots"]
rustls-tls-webpki-roots = ["librespot-core/rustls-tls-webpki-roots", "librespot-audio/rustls-tls-webpki-roots", "librespot-metadata/rustls-tls-webpki-roots"]

[dependencies]
log = "0.4"
portable-atomic = "1"
shell-words = "1.1"
thiserror = "2"
rand_distr = "0.5"
form_urlencoded = "1.2.2"

[dependencies.librespot-audio]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "../audio"
default-features = false

[dependencies.librespot-core]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "../core"
default-features = false

[dependencies.librespot-metadata]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "../metadata"
default-features = false

[dependencies.futures-util]
version = "0.3"
default-features = false
features = ["std"]

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["rt-multi-thread", "sync"]

[dependencies.zerocopy]
version = "0.8"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.alsa]
version = "0.10"
optional = true

[dependencies.jack]
version = "0.13"
optional = true

[dependencies.portaudio-rs]
version = "0.3"
optional = true

[dependencies.sdl2]
version = "0.38"
optional = true

[dependencies.gstreamer]
version = "0.24"
optional = true

[dependencies.gstreamer-app]
version = "0.24"
optional = true

[dependencies.gstreamer-audio]
version = "0.24"
optional = true

[dependencies.libpulse-binding]
version = "2"
optional = true
default-features = false

[dependencies.libpulse-simple-binding]
version = "2"
optional = true
default-features = false

[dependencies.cpal]
version = "0.16"
optional = true

[dependencies.rodio]
version = "0.21"
optional = true
default-features = false
features = ["playback"]

[dependencies.symphonia]
version = "0.5"
default-features = false
features = ["mp3", "ogg", "vorbis", "flac"]

[dependencies.ogg]
version = "0.9"
optional = true

[dependencies.rand]
version = "0.9"
default-features = false
features = ["small_rng"]

[package]
name = "librespot-protocol"
version = "0.8.0"
rust-version = "1.85"
authors = ["Paul Liétar <paul@lietar.net>"]
license = "MIT"
description = "The protobuf logic for communicating with Spotify servers"
repository = "https://github.com/librespot-org/librespot"
edition = "2024"
build = "build.rs"

[dependencies]
protobuf = "3"

[build-dependencies]
protobuf-codegen = "3"

[package]
name = "nodalia-gtk"
version = "0.1.0-alpha.1"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.85"
license = "MIT"
description = "Nodalia Design Language for GTK 4 without libadwaita: the theme and the widgets an app needs."
repository = "https://github.com/danielmigueltejedor/nodalia-design"
publish = false

[dependencies.gtk]
package = "gtk4"
version = "0.11"
features = ["v4_20"]

[dependencies.pango]
version = "0.22"
features = ["v1_56"]

[workspace]

[package]
name = "nodalia-update"
version = "0.1.0-alpha.1"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.85"
license = "MIT"
description = "In-app updates for Nodalia apps: check GitHub Releases, verify the package, replace the AppImage or the macOS app and restart."
repository = "https://github.com/danielmigueltejedor/nodalia-design"
publish = false

[features]
egui = ["dep:egui"]

[dependencies]
sha2 = "0.10"
serde_json = "1"

[dependencies.egui]
version = "0.37"
default-features = false
optional = true

[dependencies.ureq]
version = "3"
features = ["platform-verifier"]

[workspace]

[source.vendored-sources]
directory = "cargo/vendor"

[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/danielmigueltejedor/vinilo"]
git = "https://github.com/danielmigueltejedor/vinilo"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
rev = "393463e6a072c8b6fbc046641acf2e0956da4d6e"

[source."https://github.com/danielmigueltejedor/nodalia-design"]
git = "https://github.com/danielmigueltejedor/nodalia-design"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
rev = "693943d50b27c8f2a28389276e47d51779605667"
